finding: The Publish button's prototype wiring is exactly inverted: every instance that draws Publish as pressable is dead, and 55 that draw it blocked navigate.
evidence: Census of all 105 topbar instances on page 1:3: Publish=ready 23 instances, 0 with any reaction; Publish=anyway 2, 0 wired; Publish=disabled 80, 55 wired (54 -> 307:2193 'S5.4 · gate · pending', 1 -> 833:4518 'Publish · pre-checks'). Code: the disabled branch is inert by design (Topbar.tsx:315 onClick={() => {}}, aria-disabled='true'); only the enabled branch fires (Topbar.tsx:326 onClick={onPublish} -> StudioHeader.tsx:778 handleCtaClick).
fix: Move the btn/publish reaction off the 55 Publish=disabled instances and onto the 23 ready + 2 anyway ones; a disabled Publish should surface publishBlockedReason as a tooltip, not navigate.

finding: The Publish=anyway variant — one third of the topbar's main variant axis — cannot be produced by the shipping code; 'Publish anyway' is a label on the ready button, not a state.
evidence: StudioHeader.tsx:607-612 is the only producer of the publish prop and yields exactly published | disabled | ready; its own comment at :605 reads "`anyway` is gone: the derivation owns the error re-label". lifecycle.ts:123 emits the label `${label} anyway` when errorCount>0 && !blockedReason, on a ready-styled button. Topbar.tsx:734 is the single <Topbar> render site in src/ (grep). Topbar.tsx:67 and :171 keep the dead union member and dead PUBLISH_LABEL entry. Figma variants 681:46 (anyway,open) and 681:103 (anyway,none) exist; only 130:997 and 131:201 use anyway, and 681:103 is used by zero instances.
fix: Retire the anyway variant (delete 681:46 + 681:103) and re-point 130:997 / 131:201 at Publish=ready with the button text overridden to 'Publish anyway'; drop 'anyway' from PublishState in Topbar.tsx:67,171 in the same commit.

finding: Two of the four publish states the code actually ships — 'hidden' and 'published' — have no Figma variant and appear on no board.
evidence: StudioHeader.tsx:772 `publish={viewMode.readOnlyView || !nextMove ? "hidden" : publish}` — hidden ships on two live paths: view mode, and nextMove===null which lifecycle.ts:187 returns for a published site with nothing waiting (the settled state of every live site). StudioHeader.tsx:608 yields 'published' on publishOutcome, rendered as the green '✓ Published' 2s beat at Topbar.tsx:284-294. Figma Publish axis = ready|disabled|anyway only (componentPropertyDefinitions on 681:122). Text search across every TEXT node on page 1:3: '✓ Published' -> 0 hits.
fix: Add Publish=published (green ✓ Published, disabled) and Publish=none/hidden (no CTA, live chip only) to 681:122; board the live-and-settled topbar, which today has no depiction at all.

finding: The topbar's daily-loop cluster — Quick preview, Comments toggle, IssueChip — renders on every screen in code and has no node anywhere in the topbar component or in any board's topbar band.
evidence: Topbar.tsx:244-263 renders the tools cluster between the spacer and presence; StudioHeader.tsx:747 always passes `tools`, and StudioHeader.tsx:686-699 always populates at least onToggleComments (view mode) or all three. Master 681:26's nine children are btn/exit, site name, pill/saved, pill/in, spacer (680:18, empty frame, 0 children), presence, btn/notifications, btn/publish, btn/more — no preview, no comments, no issue chip. Band scan of 65:2, 200:2, 199:205, 52:2, 65:211: the only node with y<56 is the Topbar instance (plus two hotspot rects on 52:2). Text 'Quick preview' -> 0 hits on page 1:3.
fix: Add the three-control cluster to 681:122 between spacer and presence, with an IssueChip count variant; board 200:2 (Comment mode) cannot show its own pressed toggle until this exists.

finding: The live-site chip '● Live · <host>' is in the shipping topbar and is drawn nowhere.
evidence: Topbar.tsx:217-236 renders an anchor with a green dot and hostOf(liveUrl); wired at StudioHeader.tsx:777 `liveUrl={viewMode.readOnlyView ? null : publishedUrl}`. Topbar.tsx:141-150 states it is load-bearing: when nextMove is null the CTA disappears and this chip is the only thing left saying the site is live. Master 681:26 has no such child. Page 1:3 text search: 'Live ·' 0 hits; 'vercel.app' hits only at dy>=112 (641:2652 Publish · panel, 784:4250/4326/4403, 912:4520, 1177:4859) — never in a topbar band.
fix: Add the live chip to 681:122 beside pill/saved, and pair it with the Publish=hidden variant from SH-B-03 — together they are the whole 'site is live, nothing pending' bar.

finding: The Review axis has two values for six code states and cannot express the one review state that looks different — 'Changes requested', the only amber pill.
evidence: StudioHeader.tsx:135-142 REVIEW_PILL maps six ReviewStatus states to five distinct labels: 'In review', 'Opened · no reply', 'Changes requested', 'Approved', 'Approved · edited since', plus null. Topbar.tsx:351-355 gives tone 'warning' its own look (tw:bg-yellow-50 tw:text-yellow-800) while info and success share the neutral surface. Figma: Review = open|none only, and pill/in (680:15) is a plain FRAME hard-coded to 'In review · 3 open', not an instance-swap, so no board can select a state. Page 1:3 text search: 'Changes requested' -> 0 hits anywhere, including its own board 130:599 whose topbar reads 'In review · 3 open'.
fix: Convert pill/in to an INSTANCE_SWAP prop backed by a 5-variant Review pill component set (info x3 / warning / none), the way Save#698:0 already works.

finding: 85 of 105 topbar instances render the identical review pill 'In review · 3 open', a shape the code cannot produce — no code path appends an open-comment count to the review pill.
evidence: Distinct topbar text sets across the census: 85 instances read ['‹ Exit','Bella Cucina','Saved 2m ago','In review · 3 open','Publish']. Code labels are fixed strings (StudioHeader.tsx:137-141); the only dynamic suffix is the reviewer name plus pillAgo for 'approved' (StudioHeader.tsx:713-716, :166-171). Review=open on 101 of 105 instances vs Review=none on 4 (807:4299, 65:2, 297:1972, 807:6558). Every S5.2 state board except 130:798 and 130:997 carries the pending pill: 130:400 opened-not-acted, 130:599 changes-requested, 131:201 approved-edited-since, 131:415 re-sent.
fix: Set Review=none on every board that is not depicting an open round, and override the pill text per state on the ones that are; drop the '· 3 open' count, which nothing renders.

finding: The CTA's verb is state-dependent in code and fixed in every board — three of the five labels the shell can produce appear on no topbar in the file.
evidence: lifecycle.ts produces 'Send for review' (:141), 'Open feedback' (:168), 'Publish' / 'Publish changes' (:117) and the '… anyway' suffix (:123); StudioHeader.tsx:775 passes it as ctaLabel and Topbar.tsx:319 and :331 both render `ctaLabel ?? PUBLISH_LABEL[publish]`, so even the disabled branch carries the verb. Page 1:3 text search of every TEXT node: 'Open feedback' -> 0 hits; 'Publish changes' -> 0 hits; 'Send for review' -> hits only at dy>=94 (inside panels/canvas), never in a topbar band. Consequence: board 130:2 (reviewState none on an approval workspace, lifecycle.ts:138-148 -> 'Send for review') draws 'Publish', and 130:599 (changes-requested -> 'Open feedback') draws 'Publish'.
fix: Override the btn/publish label per board to the verb lifecycle.ts derives for that state; 'Publish changes' in particular is the label a live site shows most of the time and is drawn nowhere.

finding: Four of the six save-pill fills disagree with the code, and two are severity-inverted — Figma draws conflict red and offline gray; the code draws both amber.
evidence: Figma component set 697:461 variant fills: 697:444 saved #def7ec, 697:448 saving #f3f4f6, 697:452 unsaved #fdfdea, 697:456 conflict #fde8e8, 697:460 offline #f3f4f6, 701:2 error #fde8e8. Code SaveStatus.tsx:62-69: saved/saving/unsaved tw:bg-transparent, conflict tw:bg-yellow-50 (#fdfdea), offline tw:bg-yellow-50, error tw:bg-red-100 (#fde8e8). Only 'error' matches. SaveStatus.tsx:58-61 states the divergence as a deliberate rule (T8/D7 rule 4) that the component was never updated to. Copy matches exactly (SaveStatus.tsx:41-52 vs the six variants' text).
fix: Per the founder precedence rule (visual -> the board), repaint 697:461: saved/saving/unsaved to no surface with only the dot carrying state, offline to the amber tint, conflict to amber. Applies to all 105 instances at once.

finding: The save pill is a real button in only two states, and the prototype wires it in the wrong ones: 8 of the 10 actionable pills are dead and 2 of the 4 wired ones sit on a state that is never clickable.
evidence: SaveStatus.tsx:82 `const actionable = Boolean(onRetry) && (state === 'error' || state === 'unsaved')` — only those two render a <button> (:104-111); onRetry is wired at StudioHeader.tsx:745. Census: 4 instances use State=unsaved (807:4299, 65:2, 807:6558, 2209:11816) and 6 use State=error (2162:11838, 1702:7425, 1703:7445, 1703:7914, 1703:8556, 1703:10185). Only 65:2 and 2162:11838 carry a pill/saved reaction (both -> 2162:11660 'Shell state 14 · Saving'). The other two wired pills, 963:4474 and 52:2, are State=saved and point at 813:4836 'S1.2f · save-indicator · 5-states', a 1440x360 reference strip rather than a screen.
fix: Wire pill/saved -> 2162:11660 on the eight remaining unsaved/error instances; remove the reaction from 963:4474 and 52:2, where the pill is a status span.

finding: The prototype makes the exit guard unconditional — 103 of 105 exits open it — while the product shows it only for dirty, saving, offline-with-changes or stranded-mirror sessions; a clean exit is depicted on no board.
evidence: Reaction census: btn/exit -> 1172:4804 on 103 instances, -> 65:412 on 2. Code StudioHeader.tsx:393-419 guardNavigation: dialog only when (offline && isDirty), or isDirty || saveStatus==='saving' || saveStatus==='error', or totalPendingMirrors() > 0; otherwise it calls nav() straight through to `${DASHBOARD_URL}/dashboard/projects` (:481-483). 92 of the 105 instances carry Save status/State=saved, so on those the prototype shows a dialog the product would never open. Board 927:4474 'Exit · Workspace' is the destination of zero of the 105 exits.
fix: Point btn/exit at the dashboard destination on the clean-save boards and keep 1172:4804 only on the dirty/offline/save-failed ones (65:2, 66:441, 2162:11838, 2209:11816 and the five S7 save-error boards); give 927:4474 a door or mark it RETIRED.

finding: Two topbar instances send ‹ Exit to the editor's own loading screen, which exit never reaches.
evidence: Reaction census: btn/exit -> 65:412 'Shell state 12 · Loading' on 963:4474 ('Shell · 360 overlay panel (slot proof)') and 52:2 ('S1 · Editor — ASSEMBLED'). Code StudioHeader.tsx:481-483 navigates to `${DASHBOARD_URL}/dashboard/projects`; nothing in the exit path re-enters the editor.
fix: Re-point both to 1172:4804 or to the dashboard destination per SH-B-11.

finding: View mode reconfigures five of the topbar's slots and no instance of the component depicts it; the one board that draws it hand-builds its bar instead of instancing 681:122.
evidence: editorViewMode.ts:81 readOnlyView = ?view=readonly, NOT dev-gated (unlike railMode at :71-76), reachable from the owner's own site menu (StudioHeader.tsx:832 onToggleReadOnlyView). It changes exitLabel to '‹ Back to editing' (StudioHeader.tsx:740), drops the save pill (:741), drops the live chip (:777), sets publish='hidden' (:772) and trims tools to comments only (:686-687). All 105 topbar instances read '‹ Exit' (census text sets). Text 'Back to editing' -> exactly one hit on page 1:3, board 1343:7162 'S1.6 · view-mode · stripped…' at dy20, which carries no instance of 681:122.
fix: Add a Mode=edit|view axis to 681:122 (or a 'view' Publish value) and rebuild 1343:7162's bar from the component, so the view-mode topbar inherits every future fix.

finding: Presence is never drawn: all 105 instances use the empty solo variant and zero override the swap — including the presence board itself, whose topbar shows no presence.
evidence: Census: Presence#695:0 = 692:421 on 105 of 105 instances, 0 overrides. 692:421 'State=solo' is a 1x24 frame with 0 children — it renders nothing. The four populated variants 692:433 few, 692:447 many, 692:459 reconnecting, 692:471 offline are used by no topbar instance in the file. Board 642:3696 '[design-ahead] Shell state 13 · Presence (multiplayer)' has topbar 682:5899 with Presence#695:0 = 692:421. In code the whole prop is gated on collabOn (StudioHeader.tsx:217, :748-751) and CLAUDE.md forbids shipping collab, so an empty slot is correct for production — the four populated variants are unshippable by construction. Separately, connection='offline' (Presence.tsx:17,58,64) has no producer: StudioHeader.tsx:754 passes only 'live' or 'reconnecting', so 692:471 is unreachable even with collab on.
fix: Draw the presence stack inside 642:3696's topbar (Presence=692:433) so the one board about presence depicts it, and mark 692:471 State=offline as unreachable or delete it; leave the other 104 on solo.

finding: Every board in the file shows the notification bell with an unread dot; the ordinary zero-unread bar is depicted nowhere.
evidence: Visibility scan across all 105 topbar instances: the 'unread' ellipse 698:437 is visible on 105/105, and no descendant of any topbar instance is hidden anywhere in the file (hiddenByName = {}). All 105 wire btn/notifications -> 165:2 'Notifications · unread'. Code Topbar.tsx:274-279 renders the dot only when unreadCount > 0, and :269 changes the accessible label with it; unread comes from useUnreadCount (StudioHeader.tsx:236).
fix: Hide 698:437 on the boards that are not about notifications, and give the bell a read/empty destination for at least one of them.

finding: Board 130:2 'S5.2 · none' reads correctly only by accident — its topbar still says Review=open and shows no pill because the pill layer was deleted rather than the variant switched.
evidence: 682:4551.componentProperties = {"Publish":{"value":"ready"},"Review":{"value":"open"}}, mainComponent 681:26. Its main component's children include pill/in/680:15; the instance's children are btn/exit, site name, pill/saved, spacer, presence, btn/notifications, btn/publish, btn/more — pill/in absent. No topbar descendant is hidden anywhere in the file, so this is a deleted sublayer, not a visibility override. Resetting the instance restores 'In review · 3 open' onto the board whose name is 'none'.
fix: Set Review=none on 682:4551 and reset its overrides.

finding: The two boards for the same code state contradict each other, and both draw a CTA that state cannot produce.
evidence: 130:997 'S5.2 · approved-but-edited-since' topbar 682:4676 = Publish anyway + pill 'Approved · edited since'; 131:201 'S5.6 · approved-edited-since' topbar 682:4726 = Publish anyway + pill 'In review · 3 open'. One code path serves both: lifecycle.ts:177-181 approved-edited-since -> publishMove, whose label is 'Publish changes' or 'Publish' (lifecycle.ts:117) and only gains ' anyway' when errorCount > 0 (:123) — which is about open issues, not about a stale approval. The pill for that state is 'Approved · edited since' (StudioHeader.tsx:141).
fix: Make 131:201 match 130:997's pill, and change both CTAs to 'Publish changes' unless the board is also depicting open errors.

finding: 45 of the 100 review pills are dead, and the 55 that work all land on the pending screen regardless of which review state the board is in.
evidence: Reaction census: pill/in carries a reaction on 55 of the 100 instances that have one, and every one of the 55 targets 130:201 'S5.2 · pending'. In code the pill is a button only when onClick is supplied, and every state opens the same Review panel (StudioHeader.tsx:718-719, Topbar.tsx:364-383 — ReviewBadge renders a span with no onClick, 'a button that does nothing is worse than a label that never claimed to'). Landing on 130:201 from 130:798 (approved) or 130:599 (changes-requested) walks the prototype backwards into a different review state.
fix: Point pill/in at the Review panel board rather than at 130:201, and wire it on the remaining 45 instances so the pill is a door everywhere it is a button.

finding: Variant usage census: one of the six variants is used by nothing, and three quarters of the file depicts the editor with publishing blocked — a state that only a flag-off workspace, a viewer, or an offline session can reach.
evidence: 105 topbar instances on page 1:3: Publish=disabled/Review=open 77; ready/open 22; disabled/none 3; anyway/open 2; ready/none 1; anyway/none (681:103) 0. Save#698:0 is left at the 697:444 default on 92 of 105 (13 overrides: 6 error, 4 unsaved, 1 offline, 1 conflict, 1 saving). Presence#695:0 is left at the default on 105 of 105. Code: publishBlocker (lifecycle.ts:104-109) returns non-null only for !publishEnabled, isViewer, or offline; a signed-in owner on a normal workspace gets 'ready', which 22 boards depict.
fix: Flip the default topbar state on the non-permission boards to Publish=ready, and delete 681:103 (anyway/none) unless SH-B-02's retirement removes the axis outright.
